messages.content: Hello, Li Fang. It is a nice Sunday afternoon in Haidian. Do you want to go to Wukesong Park?
I'm free, Wei Ming. Yes, I think flying kites there would be fun. Do you bring your own kite?
Yes, I brought a red dragon kite. My grandson helped me fix it yesterday. It is very big.
That's great! Oh, I see. A red dragon kite is traditional. Can you fly it alone?

I hear you, Wei Ming. I know it's tough when you're tired, but practicing in English is how you get faster. If a word goes missing, just point to it and I'll help.
Okay, I try again. It is hard for me to run fast. My old knees hurt a little.
Well, your knees are important. Maybe we can walk slowly to the lake instead? There's a nice path near the gate.
Walking is better. Do you know where the badminton court is? My friend said it is near the south gate.
Yes, it's right there! You can go there after we drink some tea. I have some jasmine tea in my bag.
Jasmine tea is my favourite. Thank you, Li Fang. We will have a good time today.
Of course! Let's go to the south gate now. It's not far from here.

Oh, really? That sounds hard work. I am helping a friend fix a kitchen in Qingdao last month.

messages.content: Hi Wang. I am Zhao Jing. I am renovating my old apartment in Qingdao today.
Oh, really? That is exciting. Are you painting the walls or just the kitchen?
Actually, I am painting the furniture. My old dining table is very ugly.
I see. You should buy some new varnish. It will make it look much better.
I am going to the hardware store now to buy some paint. Do you want to come?
Well, I think I should stay home to fix my roof. Can you help me later?
I can't help you. I need to finish the table. You know, I am very worried about the smell.
Oh, that is normal. Paint smells bad for a while. You should open the windows.
Yes, I am opening them now. But the new kitchen cabinets are heavy.
I see. Heavy things are hard to move. Ask a friend to help you carry them.
I have to do this myself because my family is not here right now.
Well, you must be careful. Safety is very important when you work alone.
I know. I will be very careful. Please, can you speak Chinese to me?
I understand -- English can feel tiring sometimes. But practicing in English is how you get faster. If a word goes missing, ask me.
